whyUs.description: SEO is a long game. We build month over month, not one-off audits left to gather dust. Results compound, and so does your client's MRR.

faq.question: How long before we see results?
faq.answer: Typically 3 to 6 months for meaningful ranking movement on competitive terms. Technical fixes and low-competition keywords move faster, sometimes within weeks. AEO citation results can appear sooner.

faq.question: What's the difference between SEO and AEO?
faq.answer: SEO targets traditional search engines (Google, Bing). AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) targets AI tools that generate direct answers: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews. We optimize for both because AI search is already eating significant query share.

faq.question: Do you need CMS access?
faq.answer: Yes, for on-page work. We'll request editor-level access to publish optimized content and meta tags. We never need admin credentials.

faq.question: Can I add this on top of a web dev project?
faq.answer: Absolutely, and we recommend it. A new site without ongoing SEO won't rank. Bundling both is the strongest position for your client.

faqExtra.question: Do you guarantee rankings?
faqExtra.answer: No — and be wary of anyone who does. Rankings depend on competition, domain history, and algorithm changes nobody controls. What we commit to: the full scope delivered every month, transparent reporting, and compounding progress you can defend to your client.

faqExtra.question: What exactly is a keyword cluster?
faqExtra.answer: A group of closely related terms targeting one intent — e.g. "emergency plumber austin" plus its variations. One cluster typically covers 5–15 keywords, one target page, and its supporting content. Your quote lists every cluster before you commit.

faqExtra.question: What if my client asks who does the work?
faqExtra.answer: The same answer as every growX service: it's your team. Reports carry your brand, calls are yours, and our partner terms make that confidentiality contractual.

faqExtra.question: What happens in the first month?
faqExtra.answer: Full technical audit and fixes, keyword-cluster research, baseline reporting, and quick wins on low-competition terms — so your client sees motion in the very first report, not a "please wait six months" email.
